sources: crates/kestrike/src/storage/writable.rs, module documentation: "Close refuses new receives, reservations and publications."
crates/kestrike/src/storage/readiness.rs, module documentation, invariant ALLOCATION-READY: "Fills and builders admitted earlier keep their reservations or escrowed extents in every state."
disagrees: After the owner closes, a fill of several extents whose placement was promised before the close still places extents and is granted its shard hold. Source 1 forbids that if the hold is a new reservation. Source 2 can be read to permit it, since the builder was admitted before the close.
